title: Fox in the Attic
description: A realistic fox with glowing blue eyes stands on an old wooden chest inside a dilapidated attic, sniffing a paintbrush on the floor. Behind it, a large eerie child's face emerges from a cracked wall while an oil lamp casts warm light over scattered papers, a broken clock, and debris.
prompt: A red fox with glowing electric blue eyes stands on an old wooden chest inside a dark abandoned attic, sniffing a paintbrush lying on the floor. A giant pale bald child's face with sad eyes emerges from a heavily cracked wall behind it. An oil lantern emits warm light, scattered old papers, broken clock, empty picture frame, cobwebs and dust cover the scene, dark surreal atmosphere, cinematic lighting
